title: Billy Graham’s reign and Backlund’s breakthrough
summary: Superstar Billy Graham displaces Bruno Sammartino. Bob Backlund then challenges the flamboyant champion and emerges as the next long-term titleholder.

chapters.title: Graham dethrones Sammartino
chapters.result: Billy Graham wins the WWWF championship from Bruno Sammartino.
chapters.context: The title moves from the established hero to a very different champion.

chapters.title: Backlund defeats Graham
chapters.context: Backlund’s victory closes the Graham championship chapter indexed here.
